newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index down on new clampdown rumours.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index down on new clampdown rumours.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended slightly down on Wednesday with new rumours of impending clampdown measures swirling around the markets, but institutions were seen supporting shares with a heavy index weighting, brokers said.
The index fell 0.116 points or 0.13 percent to 88.175 points on thin volume of 12.946 million shares worth $8.145 million.
Romours said new regulations were to be announced extending the settlement period to three days from the current one day for A shares and immediate trade for B shares, brokers said.
